newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of rain-delayed Benson and Hedges Cup (5O overs) group matches on Tuesday:
At Lakenham: Derbyshire beat Minor Counties by six wickets. Minor Counties 256-7 in 50 overs (R.Dalton 76, M.Fell 67). Derbyshire 260-4 in 48.1 overs (C.Adams 138).
In Dublin: Ireland beat Middlesex by 46 runs. Ireland 281-4 in 50 overs (H.Cronje 94 not out, J.Curry 75). Middlesex 235 all out in 46.4 overs.
At Trent Bridge: Nottinghamshire beat Durham by five wickets. Durham 230-5 in 50 overs (D.Boon 64 not out). Nottinghamshire 234-5 in 49.3 overs (G.Archer 111 not out).
At Old Trafford: Yorkshire beat Lancashire by 49 runs. Yorkshire 203 all out in 48 overs. Lancashire 154 all out in 45.4 overs (N H Fairbrother 64 not out).
